method: Decode exact original GLB indices/positions and world transforms. Match edges by bit-identical decoded coordinate tuples without tolerance or mesh edits, including material/flat-normal index seams. Each closed connected component must have exactly two oppositely directed incidents per edge and positive original signed volume. No repaired diagnostic copy is used as acceptance evidence.
limitations: Tests oriented original triangle topology, not inter-component intersections, biological reconstruction or screen-space readability.
